lava_slime.name: Lava Slime
lava_slime.description: A molten ooze born in the dungeon's deeper vents. Resilient and slow, it guards chambers and hurls searing spikes across open lanes.
lava_slime.behavior: Pursues the nearest hero. Can only launch Lava Spikes when aligned horizontally; sidestep up or down to break its aim.
lava_slime.unlock_hint: Undiscovered foe. Explore the dungeon to encounter this creature.

skills.name: Slime Melee
skills.description: Heavy close-range slam against adjacent heroes.

skills.name: Lava Spike
skills.description: Telegraphed molten projectile fired along horizontal line of sight.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.description: Restless bones animated by dark will. Swift and relentless, they surge through dungeon halls or rise anew from dark rituals.
skeleton.behavior: Rushes past frontliners to hunt Healers and Ranged allies first, unless a Knight's Taunt draws its aggro.
skeleton.unlock_hint: Undiscovered foe. Explore the dungeon to encounter this creature.

skills.name: Bone Slash
skills.description: Fast close-range strike against nearby heroes.

skills.name: Bone Cleave
skills.description: Heavy overhead strike that deals high burst damage.

skeleton_archer.name: Skeleton Archer
skeleton_archer.description: A skeletal marksman that loiters at the edge of battle, loosing bone-tipped shafts from safety.
skeleton_archer.behavior: Kites backward whenever heroes approach, maintaining distance between telegraphed arrow volleys.
skeleton_archer.unlock_hint: Undiscovered foe. Explore the dungeon to encounter this creature.

skills.name: Bone Arrow
skills.description: Telegraphed long-range shot fired along clear line of sight.

necromancer.name: Necromancer
necromancer.description: A robed dark mage who commands the restless dead from the rear, steadily overwhelming careless parties.
necromancer.behavior: Retreats away from approaching heroes while channeling summoning circles that raise weaker undead minions until slain.
necromancer.unlock_hint: Undiscovered foe. Deeper chambers north hide unseen threats.

skills.name: Raise Undead
skills.description: Conjures pentagrams that summon Skeleton and Skeleton Archer minions.
